limits: Starts mid-loading; does not cover complete cold startup
Process I/O is logical I/O, not attributable physical SSD reads
System disk counters include unrelated workloads and devices
Process RSS can double-count shared pages; do not sum as physical RAM
No GPU kernel timing, cache hit attribution or power instrumentation
Sampling has overhead; collection wall time and observer CPU are recorded

analysis_rules: Keep observer-overhead condition with all measurements; do not subtract it to manufacture unobserved latency
Align by UTC timestamps and runner phase; use native per-request timing as authoritative request latency
First observation per process has no interval delta; missing process observations are unknown, not zero
Do not sum overlapping RSS, shared GPU RAM or system disk counters into model-exclusive physical usage
Keep final observer completion separate from the main protocol result and its independent audit
